text.en:
Today you tell what someone said.
Anna said she was tired.
He said the shop was closed.
Their words were before.
So am and is become was.

Someone said: I need. You tell: I said I needed.
Someone said: I will. You tell: he said he would.
We said we wanted two seats.
He said he would send a reminder.
Can becomes could.
She said she could wait.

You will tell what people said.
After told, say who first.
She told me she was downstairs.
He told us the bus was full.
To tell a question, use asked.
She asked what I needed.
